dashboard.label: 좌표 변환 예제
dashboard.description: KATEC 좌표 두 개(서울시청, 동두천 생연2동)를 geoconvert로 변환해 지도에 표시한다.

search.query: | makeresults count=2 | streamstats count as n | eval name=if(n=1, "서울시청", "동두천 생연2동"), x=if(n=1, 309946, 316730), y=if(n=1, 552085, 589063) | geoconvert x y | table name x y x_long y_lat
| makeresults count=2 | streamstats count as n | eval x=if(n=1, 309946, 316730), y=if(n=1, 552085, 589063) | geoconvert x y | geostats latfield=y_lat longfield=x_long count
